title: RentGuard Renters Policy Catch-Up Amount — Calculation Sheet
content:
The catch-up amount on a RentGuard Renters Policy is worked out in this order.

## Definitions

**Account balance.** The account balance is every installment billed, fee charged, payment returned, additional premium and refund posted on the premium account, less every payment received, fee waived, return premium and write-off posted on it, rounded half-up to the cent.

| Entries that raise the account balance | Entries that lower it |
|---|---|
| Installments billed | Payments received |
| Fees charged | Fees waived |
| Payments returned unpaid | Return premium credited |
| Additional premium charged | Balances written off |
| Refunds issued | |

Every such entry posted on the policy's premium account enters the account balance, whatever its date.

**Catch-up amount.** The catch-up amount is the account balance, never below 0.00, rounded half-up to the cent.

**Assembly.** Any amount the catch-up collects or carries beyond the account balance is added to the account balance taken at no less than 0.00, any amount taken off the catch-up is taken off, and the total, never below 0.00, is rounded half-up to the cent once, on the final figure only.

## Hypothetical worked example

*Hypothetical premium account, for illustration only:* installments billed totalling 180.00 USD; fees charged 25.00 USD; one payment returned 30.00 USD; additional premium 12.40 USD; no refund. Payments received 175.00 USD; one fee waived 20.00 USD; return premium 8.15 USD; no write-off.

1. Entries raising the balance: 180.00, 25.00, 30.00 and 12.40 USD, together 247.40 USD.
2. Entries lowering it: 175.00, 20.00 and 8.15 USD, together 203.15 USD.
3. Account balance: 247.40 USD less 203.15 USD, 44.25 USD.
4. Catch-up amount: 44.25 USD.

*Second hypothetical:* where the entries lowering the balance exceed those raising it by 6.00 USD, the account balance is a 6.00 USD credit, taken at 0.00, and the catch-up amount is 0.00 USD.
